rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ExpressVPN's MCP server allows AI assistants to manage VPN connections programmatically through natural language. Control connection state, switch between 160+ server locations, configure protocols (Lightway, OpenVPN, WireGuard), toggle Network Lock kill switch, manage split tunneling rules, and control advanced protection features like ad blocking and malware filtering. The server runs locally on your machine and communicates with the ExpressVPN desktop app, enabling automation of VPN operations without manual interaction.
